cd-pauselim-village-1863.st: SECOND SOURCES (Wabasha Herald via the MNHS hub): W. A. Johnson advertised 'Lots in the village of Pauselim' for private sale and auction, Nov-Dec 1864; the Pauselim ladies' fair to finish the Methodist church, June 1865; a spelling school, Jan 1866; the Zumbro House hotel and H. Etting's store at Pauselim, Aug 1870. 1874 delinquent-tax lists carry a 'Pauselim Village' plat under Greenfield T110 R10, and 1911-1918 lists carry 'Village of Kellogg, Pauselim addition', so the old plat is now the west part of Kellogg (fits NW1/4 sec 27).
src: Wabasha Herald tax lists 1874 and 1911-1918 (Pauselim addition to Kellogg)

cd-robbers-roost-crooked-creek.st: SECOND SOURCE: a Caledonia Junction letter in a Minnesota paper of 5 Feb 1880 (MNHS hub) says that 'just opposite the depot on the east side and on an island between the river and the railroad, there is a settlement which the people around here term as the "Robbers' Roost"'. That puts it on the island or bottoms just east of the Caledonia Junction (Reno) depot, matching the 1882 history's sec. 36 lowlands. Ground check: if the 1880 depot is placed, pin the island east of it; much may be under Pool 9 water now.
src: Caledonia Junction letter, 5 Feb 1880 (MNHS hub doc dc20e975-103e-4ff0-84d8-148592d5c699/mnhi0031/1EME5758/80020501)
